title: AWS RDS Master Password Change
description: Detects when the master password for an AWS RDS database instance is changed via ModifyDBInstance where responseElements.pendingModifiedValues.masterUserPassword is present (returned masked). Adversaries may reset the master credential to gain or maintain access to the database, which can be a precursor to data access or exfiltration.
falsePositives: Legitimate master password rotation performed by a database administrator or automation.
